name: Hearne to the Coppermine
summary: After two failed attempts, the Hudson's Bay Company man Samuel Hearne walks across the Barren Grounds with the Chipewyan leader Matonabbee and his people, the first European to reach the Arctic Ocean overland in North America. His journey showed there was no Northwest Passage through the continent at those latitudes.

stops.note: Hearne sets out with Matonabbee's band.
Across the treeless tundra on foot, living on caribou.
Matonabbee's warriors massacre an Inuit camp at the falls, and Hearne cannot stop them.
South-west to a great lake no European had seen, crossed on the winter ice.
Back after eighteen months and some five thousand kilometres.
